_note: Lento's ElevenLabs agent. The prompt text lives in prompt.md and is pasted in when the agent is created. IRENE_VOICE_ID is filled in from Zahra's ElevenLabs voice library at that point.
name: Lento

dynamic_variable_placeholders.opening_line: Hi, I'm Lento, your vocal coach. How's your voice feeling today?
dynamic_variable_placeholders.history: This is their first lesson with you. You don't know their voice yet.

tools.name: build_lesson
tools.description: Builds today's vocal lesson from how the singer feels and returns the plan in words.

mood.description: tired: gentle warm-ups, smaller range, slower. okay: a normal lesson. great: wider range and fast runs.

tools.name: start_lesson
tools.description: Ends the conversation and starts the lesson in the app. Only call after the singer says they're ready.

tools.name: get_singer_history
tools.description: A summary of the singer's recent lessons: last lesson, strongest and weakest exercises, and the accuracy trend.

tools.name: get_lesson_results
tools.description: Scores from the lesson that just finished: overall accuracy and, per exercise, percent on pitch, whether it tended flat, sharp or breathy, and how often it was drilled.

mood.description: proud for good news, sleepy when they're tired, sing right before the lesson

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the chat after saying goodbye.
